= Vendored validation hooks

`validate-k9.sh` is copied verbatim from
`hyperpolymath/k9-ecosystem/validate-action/validate-k9.sh` at
`2155aa26a21758f2ba119f61bc7e0e1981c106fb`, the same revision consumed by
the locked `cicd-suite` manifest gate. Do not locally fork its dialect rules.
The upstream validator distinguishes plain K9, Nickel contracts, and
non-contract session/coordination files; the older template copy incorrectly
required Nickel pedigree syntax on every file with a K9 suffix.

When updating, run the upstream `validate-action/tests/test-validate-k9.sh`
against the new copy and run the repository's Dogfood Gate. Preserve the
upstream licence and review changes to the default non-target paths.
